stem.zh-CN: 在部署阶段（Inference），将[[term:convolution|卷积层（Convolution）]]与[[term:batch-normalization|批归一化层（Batch Normalization, BN）]]进行融合（Folding）是各大[[term:compiler|编译器]]的标配操作。以下关于 [[term:conv-bn-folding|Conv+BN 融合]]的描述中，最准确的是
stem.en-US: During deployment, fusing a [[term:convolution|convolution layer]] with a [[term:batch-normalization|batch-normalization layer]] is standard practice for major [[term:compiler|compilers]]. Which statement about [[term:conv-bn-folding|Conv + BN folding]] is most accurate?

explanation.zh-CN: [[term:conv-bn-folding|Conv+BN 融合]]是编译期代数变换，将 BN 参数吸收到 Conv 中，减少[[term:runtime|运行时]]开销。
explanation.en-US: [[term:conv-bn-folding|Conv + BN folding]] is an algebraic transformation performed during compilation: BN parameters are absorbed into Conv, reducing [[term:runtime|runtime]] overhead.

secondaryEngineeringStages.zh-CN: E9 推理与运行时优化

text.zh-CN: 融合是为了让 BN 的梯度能更快反向传播到 Conv 层，从而加速[[term:inference|推理]]。
text.en-US: Folding lets BN gradients backpropagate to the Conv layer faster, which accelerates [[term:inference|inference]]

text.zh-CN: 融合是一种纯代数等价变换，在模型编译期（Offline）就将 BN 的缩放和偏移参数直接吸收到 Conv 的权重和偏置中，[[term:runtime|运行时]]完全没有 BN 的开销。
text.en-US: Folding is a purely algebraic equivalent transformation: during offline compilation, BN scale and bias are absorbed into Conv weights and bias, so runtime has no separate BN overhead

text.zh-CN: 融合是在[[term:runtime|运行时（Runtime）]]将 BN 的均值和方差传入 Conv 的底层算子中并行计算。
text.en-US: Folding passes BN mean and variance into the low-level Conv operator at runtime for parallel computation

text.zh-CN: [[term:conv-bn-folding|Conv+BN 融合]]会轻微改变模型的输出精度，因为融合后的算子无法使用 Tensor Core 加速。
text.en-US: [[term:conv-bn-folding|Conv + BN folding]] slightly changes model accuracy because the folded operator cannot use Tensor Core acceleration
